summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute a 727KB obfuscated bundle
details: The package's preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads a Bun runtime binary (bun-v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, unpacks it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated bundle (rotated string-array with an array-shift rotator function, mangled identifiers, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header) that is not human-readable. The package presents itself as a React/Redux 'Workbench Client server' — a role that has no need for Bun — and setup.mjs itself is written with hex-mangled identifiers and per-function string-property aliasing to obscure the download-and-exec flow. The result is that `npm install workbench-browser-server` fetches a second language runtime and executes an opaque payload on the installer's machine before any application code runs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
